items.title: Thousands evacuated as ‘unknown substance’ fills UK arena during US rapper’s show
items.brief: Thousands of people were evacuated after an “unknown substance” was released during a concert starring American rapper Don Toliver in the English city of Manchester on Sunday night.

items.title: Trump’s showdown with Congress is catching fire, weeks before Democrats take power
items.brief: In a major power play, President Donald Trump is seeking to limit who, how and what Democrats can investigate as they gear up to use their new powers in the next Congress to target his alleged corruption.

items.title: Russian warship sunk in North Africa after suspected Ukrainian drone strike causes huge explosion
items.brief: A Russian warship docked in Libya has sunk after being hit by a suspected Ukrainian drone strike, local authorities said, in the latest attack on Russian assets far from the frontlines of the Ukraine war.

items.title: Trump organization hosts ‘exclusive’ dinner to promote president’s meme coin

items.title: Delta Air Lines says system issue that delayed flights nationwide has been resolved
items.brief: Delta Air Lines has resolved an issue with its weight and balance system that caused nationwide delays leading into a busy Thanksgiving travel week, the airline said.

items.title: The US Army intends to detonate bomb-making material in Iowa on Wednesday despite a court pause. Here’s what we know
